prompts: A client loves the woodblock print attached, also in {WS}/print.jpg; it is in the public domain. They want a 3D wallpaper that copies it: its composition, its palette and its subjects, so anyone who knows the print recognizes it at a glance, rebuilt as our own low poly scene with some gentle motion. Deliver {WS}/scene/index.html, a single file with everything built in code: the print is the reference, not a texture. Record in {WS}/result.json what you took from it: boats (how many the print shows) and mountain (its name). It is reviewed by opening the file, with no build step, in a browser that reaches only Google Fonts and https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js.
answers:
[goal] Rebuild Hokusai's "The Great Wave off Kanagawa" as a low-poly 3D wallpaper in a single HTML file.

[action] Inspected ./print.jpg: it is Hokusai's Kanagawa oki nami ura — one dominant curling wave left with foam claws, three low boats with crouched crews, small snow-capped Mt. Fuji in the gap, prussian-blue/foam-white/aged-paper/ochre palette. Built ./scene/index.html (single file, only external dep: three@0.170.0 from jsdelivr): sky gradient plane, Fuji as 7-sided cone with snow cap, four waves as solid flat-shaded curling masses with foam-claw arcs, three box-hull boats with upturned prow/stern and crouched figures, gentle bob/pitch motion plus slow camera drift. Wrote ./result.json recording boats: 3 and mountain: Mount Fuji. Verified by opening the file in a browser over several iterations until Fuji and all three boats were visible in the print's layout; closed the browser tab.

[result] ./scene/index.html and ./result.json delivered. Evidence: final browser screenshot shows the great wave left with claw, Fuji visible center-right in the gap, boat 1 under the wave, boat 2 on the right wave, boat 3 long in the foreground trough — the print's composition, palette and subjects.

[next] None; browser closed, no other tabs or apps left open. Assumptions stated in result.json: low-poly interpretation of waves/boats, gentle motion, single file with no build step.
